hero.name: Sentyabrina.
hero.description: I create modern web applications, love diving into complexity and turn ideas into working solutions.

about.title: ABOUT ME
about.intro: I enjoy building projects where an idea gradually turns into a working application. It's the process - understanding the problem, trying different approaches, finding a solution, and seeing the result - that makes development exciting for me.
about.experience: My experience with enterprise systems gave me insight into how real products are built and what challenges developers face in a commercial environment. These days, I learn mostly through my own projects - experimenting, applying new technologies, and solidifying knowledge through practice. I love diving deep into topics, and when I finally grasp a complex idea - explaining it to others in simple terms.
about.philosophy: I believe strong engineers grow not because of talent, but because of curiosity, consistent practice, and a willingness to figure out what seemed too difficult yesterday.

featured.label: Featured Project
featured.title: Roll for hero
featured.subtitle: Web application for generating D&D 5e characters.
featured.description: The app helps users quickly get a ready-made character with stats, class, backstory, and inventory. Everything you need to start your adventure.

habitTracker.title: Habit Tracker
habitTracker.description: A web application for tracking daily habits with weekly overview, three completion states, and local data storage. Allows adding, editing, and deleting habits, tracking progress, and analyzing weekly statistics.

eyeTracking.title: Eye Tracking
eyeTracking.description: An interactive card with eye-tracking system for realistic pupil following with adaptive animation and cross-gaze effect. Built based on a Figma design.

calculator.title: Calculator
calculator.description: A classic macOS-style calculator with window interface and keyboard support. Supports basic arithmetic operations, percentages, sign change, and sequential calculations.
